name: Urhudo ebantwaneni
tagline: i-ORS isindisa ubomi. Yazi iimpawu zokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni.

urgent.heading: Ingxamisekile — yiya ekliniki okanye esibhedlele
urgent.primary_message: Ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni kumntwana omncinci kunokubulala ngaphakathi kweeyure. Ukuba ubona ezi mpawu, musa ukulinda. Yiya.
red_flags: Umntwana unxaniwe kakhulu kodwa akakwazi ukusela
Amehlo angene ngaphakathi, umlomo womile, akukho nyembezi xa ekhala
Indawo ethambileyo entloko yosana ingene ngaphakathi
Umchamo mncinci kakhulu okanye awukho iiyure ezi-6 okanye ngaphezulu
Ukozela kakhulu — umntwana uyozela, kunzima ukumvusa okanye akaphenduli
Ukugabha okuthintela ukugcina naluphi na ulwelo emzimbeni

what_is_it.heading: Urhudo ebantwaneni ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Urhudo lithetha ilindle elithambileyo nelinamanzi — amaxesha amathathu okanye ngaphezulu kwiiyure ezingama-24. Kubantwana abancinci, ingozi ayisiyilo rhudo ngokwalo. Kukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni okulandelayo.
paragraphs: Imizimba yabantwana mincinci kwaye baphelelwa ngamanzi ngokukhawuleza. Umntwana olahlekelwe ngamanzi amaninzi uba buthathaka, emva koko ozele, emva koko abe kwimeko embi kakhulu — ngamanye amaxesha ngaphakathi kweeyure. Urhudo lusengomnye woonobangela abaphambili bokusweleka kwabantwana baseMzantsi Afrika abangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5.

Uninzi lorhudo ebantwaneni lubangelwa ziintsholongwane kwaye luphela kwiintsuku ezi-3–5. Unyango oluphambili kukubuyisela ulwelo olulahlekileyo — i-ORS yeyona ndlela iphambili. Isimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki. Isindise izigidi zabantwana kwihlabathi.

items.headline: Umbulali ophambili
items.body: Isifo sorhudo sisengomnye woonobangela abaphambili bokusweleka kwabantwana baseMzantsi Afrika abangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 — phantse rhoqo ngenxa yokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni.

items.headline: i-ORS isindisa ubomi
items.body: I-Oral Rehydration Solution ithintela kwaye inyange uninzi lokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni. Isimahla kuyo yonke ikliniki. Ixabiso liphantsi, ilula, iyasebenza.

items.headline: Isitofu se-rotavirus
items.body: Isitofu sasimahla sabantwana eMzantsi Afrika sithintela oyena nobangela uxhaphakileyo worhudo olunzima. Sinikwa kwiiveki ezi-6 ne-14. Musa ukusitsiba.

items.headline: Akukho antibiotics
items.body: Uninzi lorhudo lubangelwa ziintsholongwane. Ii-antibiotic azincedi — kwaye zinokwenza ezinye iintlobo zibe mandundu. Musa ukuzicela; cela i-ORS.

pull_quote.text: Umntwana angalahlekelwa ngamakhulu eemililitha zorhudo ngosuku. Yonke i-250ml yelindle elilahlekileyo kufuneka ibuyiselwe nge-250ml ye-ORS — okanye nangaphezulu. Gcina ikomityi ilungile.

signs.heading: Ungalubona njani ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni
signs.lede: Ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni kukhula ngamanyathelo. Ukukubamba kwinqanaba 'lokunxanwa' kugcina umntwana engangeni esibhedlele.

items.title: Kuthambile — kunokunyangwa ekhaya
items.description: Umntwana unxaniwe, usela ngomdla, akasadlali kangako, umchamo umnyama kancinci kodwa amadiyapa asemanzi. Nika i-ORS, ubisi lwebele okanye amanzi acocekileyo.

items.title: Phakathi — yiya ekliniki
items.description: Umntwana unxaniwe kakhulu, umlomo womile, amadiyapa mancinci amanzi, akaphumli okanye uyacaphuka, amehlo angena ngaphakathi, ulusu lubuyela kancinci xa lucinezelwe. Ikliniki — hayi isibhedlele okwangoku.

items.title: Kunzima — isibhedlele ngoku
items.description: Umntwana ubuthathaka kakhulu ukuba asele, uyozela okanye akaphenduli, akukho nyembezi, akukho madiyapa manzi iiyure ezi-6 okanye ngaphezulu, indawo ethambileyo entloko yosana ingene ngaphakathi. Le yimeko engxamisekileyo.

spreads.heading: Urhudo ebantwaneni lusasazeka njani
yes: Indlela ye-faecal-oral — imiqathango encinci yelindle ingena ekutyeni, ezandleni okanye emanzini
Amanzi angcolileyo kwiindawo ezingenawo amanzi akhuselekileyo
Izandla ezingahlanjwanga emva kwendlu yangasese okanye ukutshintsha idiyapa
Ukwabelana ngeethoyi, iipacifier okanye iibhotile kwiindawo zokugcina abantwana
no: Ukukhula kwamazinyo — nangona le ntsomi ixhaphakile
Ukuncancisa — ubisi lwebele lukhusela ngokwenene kurhudo

prevention.heading: Ungamkhusela njani umntwana wakho
prevention.lede: Uninzi lorhudo ebantwaneni lunokuthintelwa ngezitofu, amanzi acocekileyo kunye nokuhlamba izandla kakuhle. Kufanelekile umzamo omncinci wemihla ngemihla.

items.title: Isitofu se-rotavirus
items.description: Isitofu sasimahla sabantwana eMzantsi Afrika kwiiveki ezi-6 ne-14. Sithintela oyena nobangela uxhaphakileyo worhudo olunzima ebantwaneni. Ungaze usitsibe.

items.title: Izandla ezicocekileyo, amanzi acocekileyo
items.description: Hlamba izandla ngesepha phambi kokutya, emva kwendlu yangasese, emva kokutshintsha idiyapa. Sebenzisa amanzi akhuselekileyo okusela nokupheka. Wabilise ukuba awuqinisekanga.

items.title: Ncancisa ukuba uyakwazi
items.description: Ubisi lwebele luqulethe izikhuseli ezikhusela kurhudo. Ukuncancisa kuphela kwiinyanga ezi-6 sesinye sezikhuselo ezomeleleyo.

items.title: Ukhuseleko lokutya
items.description: Pheka inyama ngokupheleleyo, faka okushiyekileyo efrijini ngokukhawuleza, hlamba iziqhamo nemifuno. Musa ukunika abantwana abancinci kakhulu ubisi olungapasteurizwanga okanye amaqanda angaphekwanga kakuhle.

items.title: Qalisa i-ORS kwilindle lokuqala elithambileyo
items.description: Xuba isachet enye kwi-1 litre yamanzi acocekileyo (okanye njengoko ipakethi isitsho). Nika imiselo emincinci rhoqo emva kwelindle ngalinye — 50–100ml kubantwana abangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-2, 100–200ml kubantwana abadala.

items.title: Qhubeka nokuncancisa okanye ukunika ifomula
items.description: Musa ukuyeka ukuncancisa ngexesha lorhudo — ubisi lwebele luyakhusela. Qhubeka nefomula. Iintsana zidinga ukutya kwazo okuqhelekileyo kunye ne-ORS eyongezelelekileyo.

items.title: Nika izongezo ze-zinc
items.description: Zisimahla kwiikliniki kunye ne-ORS. I-zinc inciphisa ixesha lorhudo nge-25% kwaye inciphisa ubunzima balo. Nika iintsuku ezi-10–14 njengoko ucebisiwe.

items.title: Jonga iimpawu zokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni
items.description: Jonga amadiyapa amanzi, iinyembezi xa ekhala, nokuba uphaphile. Cinezelisa kancinci ulusu lwesisu — kufuneka lubuye ngokukhawuleza. Ukuba kukho into engalunganga, yiya ekliniki.

items.title: Yiya ekliniki okanye esibhedlele ukuba iba mandundu
items.description: Ukuphelelwa ngamanzi phakathi — ikliniki. Ukuphelelwa ngamanzi kakhulu — isibhedlele. Musa ukuzithandabuza. Unyango (ulwelo lwe-IV) lukhawuleza kwaye lusindisa ubomi.

get_help.heading: Apho omawuye khona
get_help.lede: Unyango lorhudo ebantwaneni lolunye lweenkqubo ezomeleleyo zempilo yoluntu eMzantsi Afrika. i-ORS yasimahla, izitofu zasimahla, unyango lwasimahla esibhedlele ukuba luyafuneka. Lusebenzise kwangoko.
